Q8499.reason: Progressive systemic reactions after bee stings are anaphylaxis, so self-injectable epinephrine is the measure that prevents death; antihistamines and avoidance alone do not.

Q8501.reason: Hobbes treats the pre-contract state of nature as a war of all against all, while Locke treats it as a condition of natural rights that is insecure but not inherently a state of war.

Q8503.reason: Through the Universal Periodic Review the Council examines the human rights records of all UN member states; it has 47 members, replaced the Commission on Human Rights, and cannot impose economic sanctions.
